# FIP - International Pharmaceutical Federation

> > The global federation advancing pharmacy practice, pharmaceutical sciences, and workforce development through continuing professional development resources and education.

FIP (International Pharmaceutical Federation) provides educational resources and professional development tools for pharmacists worldwide. The organization focuses on enhancing pharmacy practice through self-directed learning modules covering patient care, vaccination, and management of common ailments.

## Key Topics

- FIP (International Pharmaceutical Federation)
- CPD (Continuing Professional Development)
- CPD Bites
- Pharmacy education
- Pharmacist training
- Self-directed learning
- Patient care
- Vaccination programs
- Human Papillomavirus (HPV)
- Common ailments management
- Pharmaceutical practice
- Professional development

## Continuing Professional Development

- [FIP CPD Bites – CONTRIBUTING TO YOUR SELF-DIRECTED LEARNING](https://cpdbites.fip.org/): Self-directed learning resources for pharmacist continuing professional development
